title: Scout (trace-callers): every read of the codex model, tier map and fallback_tier; slots for a multi-executor table
spec: Skill trace-callers. Trace and cite path:line for every reader of: pool.cfg["codex"] (all keys: model, max_parallel, daily_budget_tasks, pace_reserve, on_exhausted, dangerous_full_access, home), pool.cfg["models"], fallback_tier(), Pool.codex_available(), Pool.codex (state object: cooldown_until, day_tasks, running), the `-m` argument in executor._run/start/reply, and bus.log_run tier/account fields. Then propose, with minimal change, where a `[[executors]]` table in pool.toml (id, provider codex|claude, model, max_parallel, daily_budget_tasks, roles, complexity_min/max, enabled) would plug in: which function picks an executor for a task (role, complexity), where per-executor cooldown state lives (pool_state.json shape), and how run logs would carry executor id. List every test in tests/test_orchestrator.py that reads these fields (PoolSel, Executor tests). Max 20 findings, rank by blast radius.
acceptance: covers pool.py, executor.py, spawn.py, cli.py, daemon.py, tests
suggested_next lists the insertion points in order of blast radius
